svg.title: nODD proposed compact HCAL with tracker, solenoid and ECAL, R-Z
svg.desc: Proposed compact HCAL envelope and sampling-stack schematic, not adopted or native-validated. Tracker/ECAL/solenoid unchanged from parent named layout. Dashed HCAL outlines show the previous envelope. Hatching between HCAL barrel and endcap marks an unconstructed ECAL-service exit reservation. Individual module/sector gaps and tracker passives unresolved; no installed solenoid field or engineering acceptance.
svg.text: DES043 tracker + solenoid allocation + 400 mm-gap LAr ECAL + 60-layer HCAL • 21 November 2026
Equal r–z scale • 1.04 m shorter overall • proposed envelope, not yet adopted
30 mm steel + 12 mm cassette + 1 mm allowance
Proposed HCAL barrel: |z| ≤ 5.740 m. Endcaps: |z| 6.240–8.830 m. Radial bounds and 60-layer depth retained.
Polygon radii are face apothems; barrel corner reaches R 5.832 m. Steel: light orange; readout cassettes: dark orange.
ECAL: pale yellow = warm package; yellow = sampling. Solenoid: hatched vessel, grey cold-mass allocation, dashed reservation.
Dashed orange: previous HCAL outline. Yellow hatching: relocated 500 mm service-exit reservation; no installed route.
ECAL warm gap 400 mm: |z| 4.100–4.500 m; endcaps |z| 4.500–5.660 m. External routes remain empty reservations.
43 barrel rows, retaining the 80 mm cassette/flange allowance. Native geometry, services and transition response await validation.
